[.verse-line]
[.i149]##{nbsp}##Kind Katharine to her husband kiss’d these words,
[.i149]##{nbsp}##‘Mine own sweet _Will,_ how dearly I love thee!’
[.i148]##{nbsp}##If true (quoth Will) the World no such affords.
[.i155]##{nbsp}##And that its true I durst his warrant be;
[.i263]##{nbsp}##For ne’er heard I of Woman good or ill,
[.i261]##{nbsp}##But always loved best, her own sweet Will.
